name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: Blood draw measuring red cells, white cells, and platelets.

name: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)
description: Blood draw checking glucose, electrolytes, and kidney function.

name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
description: Blood draw covering the BMP plus liver function markers.

name: Lipid Panel
description: Blood draw measuring total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and triglycerides.

name: Hemoglobin A1C (Lab)
description: Lab blood draw for 3-month average blood sugar control.

name: Thyroid Panel (TSH, T3, T4)
description: Blood draw assessing thyroid hormone levels.

name: Liver Function Tests
description: Blood draw checking liver enzymes and function.

name: Kidney Function Panel
description: Blood and urine tests assessing kidney function.

name: Urinalysis
description: Lab analysis of a urine sample.

name: Electrocardiogram (EKG/ECG)
description: Records the heart's electrical activity.

name: Echocardiogram
description: Ultrasound imaging of the heart's structure and function.

name: Chest X-Ray
description: Imaging of the lungs, heart, and chest wall.

name: Mammogram
description: X-ray imaging of breast tissue, a breast cancer screen.

name: Pap Smear (Cervical Cytology)
description: Sample of cervical cells to screen for abnormal changes.

name: Colonoscopy
description: Camera examination of the colon, a colon cancer screen.

name: Bone Density Scan (DEXA)
description: Low-dose X-ray measuring bone mineral density.

name: Pulmonary Function Test (Spirometry)
description: Breathing test measuring lung capacity and airflow.

name: Cardiac Stress Test
description: Monitors heart activity during exercise or medication-induced stress.

name: MRI Scan
description: Magnetic imaging of soft tissue, organs, or joints.

name: CT Scan
description: Cross-sectional X-ray imaging of the body.

name: Abdominal Ultrasound
description: Sound-wave imaging of abdominal organs.

name: Vision Exam
description: Eye exam checking visual acuity and eye health.

name: Hearing Test (Audiometry)
description: Assesses hearing sensitivity across frequencies.

name: Dental Exam and Cleaning
description: Routine dental checkup and professional cleaning.

name: Skin Cancer Screening
description: Visual exam of the skin for suspicious moles or lesions.

name: Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) Test
description: Blood draw used to screen for prostate conditions.

name: STI/STD Panel (Lab)
description: Lab panel screening for common sexually transmitted infections.

name: Hepatitis Panel
description: Blood draw screening for hepatitis A, B, and C.

name: HIV Test (Lab)
description: Blood or oral sample screening for HIV.

name: Vitamin D Level (Lab)
description: Blood draw measuring vitamin D levels.

name: Iron Panel / Ferritin
description: Blood draw assessing iron stores, checks for anemia.

name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
description: Blood draw measuring general inflammation levels.

name: Sleep Study (Polysomnography)
description: Overnight monitoring to diagnose sleep disorders.

name: Allergy Skin Test
description: Skin-prick testing to identify specific allergens.
